body.zh-CN: 商城页面只能把包交给宿主暂存。启用、信任与升级一律由管理员在 core 的扩展页面完成；商城不会代劳，也不会后台静默安装。
body.en-US: The store page can only hand a package to the Host for staging. Enabling, trusting and upgrading always happen in core; the store never does it silently.

description.zh-CN: 商城服务端基址（https）。留空时管理页只显示配置提示，不会发起任何请求。
description.en-US: Base URL of the store service (https). When empty the admin page shows a setup hint and makes no requests.

description.zh-CN: stable 只列稳定版；beta 会同时列出预发布版本。
description.en-US: stable lists stable releases only; beta also lists pre-releases.
